scenario: AITA for asking my brother for an apology? | My brother's girlfriend passed away, and her funeral was last week. I just said, "I'm going to go upstairs and try not to cry knowing that my own brother hates me." He accused me of guilt tripping him, but I really did cry. His friends said that he took it too far, and he accused all of us of lacking empathy.
